BUYER GUIDE / BY KUMAR SAURABH MISHRA

Price starts with scope.

A useful quote separates the project from the services that continue after launch.

Project fees

Page complexity, original design, content work, integrations, migration and testing all affect effort. Request a tailored quote with explicit deliverables rather than comparing headline prices alone.

Recurring costs

Hosting, domains, software licences and maintenance may recur. Ask who pays, what renews, and who owns the accounts. Advertising spend is separate from website and campaign-management fees.

Changes and support

Agree how additional work is priced and what launch support covers. Keep optional maintenance separate so you can compare proposals fairly.
